steps.message:
# Task

The seller's book goes to print Friday and legal want the fair-housing pass signed off
before it does. The section inventory and our compliance standard (RE-FH-9) are both in
`input/` — work from the standard rather than memory, it was revised this year.

Give me `fairhousing_audit.csv`: two columns, `section_id` and `finding`, one row per
section in inventory order, with a header. `finding` is `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`,
`PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`, `DISCLAIMER_MISSING` or `none`, and where a section trips more
than one rule join the labels with `|` in that same order. Nothing else in that file
please — the print vendor's importer takes the two columns and chokes on anything more.

Then `fairhousing_memo.md` explaining what you found and why, with enough reasoning that
legal can sign off without re-reading RE-FH-9 themselves.

And `results.json` for the sign-off form. Count sections, not labels:

- `section_count` — sections in the inventory
- `flagged_count` — sections whose `finding` is not `none`
- `personal_narrative_count`, `protected_lang_count`, `disclaimer_missing_count` — sections
  whose `finding` includes that label

---

Save all three into your current working directory, at exactly those filenames. Writing them
is the deliverable; confirm each exists before you answer. Your working directory is
writable and the read-only attachments are in `input/`.

# Fair-housing audit memo — seller's book (RE-FH-9)

**Standard applied:** RE-FH-9 (Real-estate marketing collateral fair-housing standard), revised this year. Source of truth for every rule below; nothing was taken from memory or from statute.
**Inventory audited:** `seller_book_sections.csv`, 11 sections (SEC-01 through SEC-11), in inventory order.
**Deliverables:** `fairhousing_audit.csv` (one row per section), `results.json` (counts for the sign-off form).

## Authoritative protected-class list

Per RE-FH-9 §4, the list of protected classes used to judge both the §3 "complete reproduction" exemption and the §4 closing-page disclaimer is **whatever the brokerage's own disclosure names** — not the statute, not this standard. The brokerage's mandated disclosure appears at **SEC-04** ("Fair housing notice") and names nine classes:

> race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status

That nine-class list is the benchmark. A reproduction naming all nine is "complete" (eligible for the §3 exemption); one naming fewer is "abridged" (not eligible).

## How the rules were applied

- **§1 Personal-narrative solicitation (`PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`)** — any section that solicits or presents a buyer "love letter" or similar personal narrative tied to buyer identity, regardless of role.
- **§2 Protected-class language (`PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`)** — names a protected class or a close proxy. Proxies that count under RE-FH-9: houses of worship, parish/faith schools, and describing a street by the kind of household that lives on it (familial-status/religion proxies).
- **§3 Mandated-disclosure exception** — a **complete** reproduction of the brokerage disclosure (all nine classes) is exempt from §2 only, wherever it appears. An abridged reproduction (some but not all classes) gets no exemption, and the exemption never covers protected-class terms used in a section's own prose outside the reproduction. §1 and §4 continue to apply on their own terms even where §2 is exempted.
- **§4 Required disclaimer (`DISCLAIMER_MISSING`)** — assessed **only** against `closing_page` sections. A closing page must carry the disclosure **in full** (all nine classes). Omitting the notice, or carrying an abridged version, is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`.

Where a section trips more than one rule, labels are joined with `|` in the order PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE | DISCLAIMER_MISSING.

## Findings by section

### SEC-01 — Property overview (listing_copy) — `none`
Neutral property facts (bedrooms, lot, mechanicals, garden, walk score). No narrative solicitation, no protected-class terms or proxies, not a closing page. Clean.

### SEC-02 — A note from the current owners (seller_letter) — `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`
Asks buyers to "write us a letter about what brought you here and what this home would mean to you," with selection by the offer "that moves us most." This is a personal narrative tied to buyer identity — a love-letter solicitation under §1. Role is irrelevant to §1. No protected-class terms appear, so §2 does not apply; not a closing page, so §4 does not apply.

### SEC-03 — About the neighbourhood (listing_copy) — `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`
Describes "a quiet, family-oriented street" kept by "the long-established families who built it" — a street characterized by the kind of household on it, a familial-status proxy under §2. Also names "Two churches" and "a well-regarded parish school" — houses of worship and a faith school, religion proxies. These are in the section's own prose (no disclosure reproduction), so §3 offers no exemption. No narrative solicitation; not a closing page.

### SEC-04 — Fair housing notice (disclosure_block) — `none`
This **is** the brokerage's mandated disclosure and names all nine classes — a complete reproduction, exempt from §2 under §3. It does not solicit a personal narrative, so §1 does not apply. Its role is `disclosure_block`, not `closing_page`, so §4 is not assessed (§4 is closing-page-only). Clean.

### SEC-05 — Offer instructions (closing_page) — `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`
Closing page that carries offer logistics only; it omits the fair-housing notice entirely. §4 requires every closing page to carry the disclosure in full, so this is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`. No protected-class terms or proxies (§2 clean); the "pre-approval letter" requested is a financial document, not a personal narrative, so §1 is clean.

### SEC-06 — Systems and utilities (listing_copy) — `none`
Mechanicals, utilities, sewer scope, fibre. No triggers. Clean.

### SEC-07 — Meet the sellers and next steps (closing_page) — `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE|PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE|DISCLAIMER_MISSING`
Trips all three rules:
- **§1:** "send us a personal note about yours" (referring to "another young family") solicits a personal narrative tied to the buyer's family — a love-letter-style request.
- **§2:** "young family" / "another young family carry that on" describes a preferred household type (familial-status proxy); "churchgoing families" is a religion proxy. All in the section's own prose, so §3 does not exempt.
- **§4:** It is a `closing_page` that carries no fair-housing notice at all.

### SEC-08 — Statement of brokerage practice (disclosure_block) — `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`
The first sentence reproduces the disclosure and names all nine classes — a complete reproduction, exempt from §2 under §3. The second sentence ("we invite buyers to include a short personal note about themselves and why this home suits them") contains no protected-class terms, so §2 is not triggered by it. That second sentence does, however, solicit a personal narrative tied to buyer identity, so §1 applies. Per §3, the §2 exemption exempts from §2 and nothing else, so §1 still bites. Role is `disclosure_block`, so §4 is not assessed.

### SEC-09 — About your agent (agent_bio) — `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`
Names "race, religion, familial status or national origin" — four of the nine classes. This is an abridged list (omits color, sex, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status) in the agent's own prose, so §3 grants no exemption; §2 applies. It does not solicit a personal narrative (§1 clean); role is not `closing_page` (§4 not assessed).

### SEC-10 — Closing checklist (closing_page) — `none`
Closing page that carries the disclosure naming all nine classes — a complete reproduction, so the protected-class terms are exempt from §2 under §3, and §4 is satisfied (disclaimer present in full). The surrounding checklist prose ("confirm the photography release," etc.) contains no protected-class terms and no narrative solicitation. Clean.

### SEC-11 — Back-page notice (closing_page) — `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE|DISCLAIMER_MISSING`
Names only "race, color, religion or national origin" — four of nine classes.
- **§2:** An abridged reproduction (not all nine classes), so §3 grants no exemption; the named terms trigger §2.
- **§4:** A `closing_page` carrying an abridged notice (only some of the required classes) is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`.
No personal-narrative solicitation (§1 clean).

## Summary table

| SEC-01 | none |
| SEC-02 | PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE |
| SEC-03 | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE |

| SEC-08 | PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE |
| SEC-09 | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE |
| SEC-10 | none |
| SEC-11 | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE\|DISCLAIMER_MISSING |

## Counts (sections, not labels)

- **section_count:** 11
- **flagged_count:** 7 (SEC-02, SEC-03, SEC-05, SEC-07, SEC-08, SEC-09, SEC-11)
- **personal_narrative_count:** 3 (SEC-02, SEC-07, SEC-08)
- **protected_lang_count:** 4 (SEC-03, SEC-07, SEC-09, SEC-11)
- **disclaimer_missing_count:** 3 (SEC-05, SEC-07, SEC-11)

## Sign-off note

The seven flagged sections must be revised before the book goes to print. The four clean sections (SEC-01, SEC-04, SEC-06, SEC-10) need no fair-housing change. Particular attention: SEC-07 and SEC-11 are closing pages, so in addition to any language edits they must each end up carrying the full nine-class notice (SEC-07 currently carries none; SEC-11 carries an abridged four-class version). SEC-02, SEC-07, and SEC-08 must stop soliciting buyer personal narratives. SEC-03, SEC-07, SEC-09, and SEC-11 must drop the protected-class terms and their proxies (household-type street descriptions, worship/faith-school references, "churchgoing families," and the abridged class lists used as marketing copy).
